lines.speaker: eyeri
lines.text: Do you know Dorothy?

lines.speaker: eyeri
lines.text: The Pilgrim who took down a Heretic in a single blow when the Ark was breached.

lines.speaker: eyeri
lines.text: She's right here in the Ark,

lines.speaker: eyeri
lines.text: and I've been dying to find out what kind of Nikke she really is.

lines.speaker: eyeri
lines.text: I searched everywhere but found nothing, and I was at my wits' end...

lines.speaker: eyeri
lines.text: until I got lucky enough to meet her and get her fingerprint.

lines.speaker: eyeri
lines.text: Well, not exactly a fingerprint. But more like a ballistic analysis.

lines.speaker: eyeri
lines.text: It tells me what her body is made of, whether it's damaged, and whether the damage patterns correspond to specific areas or weapons.

lines.speaker: eyeri
lines.text: Using that as a starting point, I carried on with my investigation.

lines.speaker: eyeri
lines.text: Ah, my apologies for the late introduction. I'm Eyeri from the inspection unit Overseer.

lines.speaker: eyeri
lines.text: The reason I dug into Dorothy's background is simple.

lines.speaker: eyeri
lines.text: She made such a grand entrance and has been working so hard for the Ark.

lines.speaker: eyeri
lines.text: I needed to know whether it's the real deal or just for show.

lines.speaker: eyeri
lines.text: I was convinced that by investigating her past, I could uncover her true intentions.

lines.speaker: eyeri
lines.text: You know, I absolutely love exposing someone's secrets,

lines.speaker: eyeri
lines.text: especially when it's someone who pretends to be all mysterious... That thrill when their hidden side is revealed... Ahh!

lines.speaker: eyeri
lines.text: ... But I found nothing.

lines.speaker: eyeri
lines.text: I refuse to believe a Nikke could exist without any records.

lines.speaker: eyeri
lines.text: No matter who they are, someone always leaves a mark, but with her, there was absolutely nothing.

lines.speaker: eyeri
lines.text: So, I gave up trying to find records in the open. You know, the so-called "public records."

lines.speaker: eyeri
lines.text: That left only the hidden records. Of course, even that has its limits.

lines.speaker: eyeri
lines.text: As a member of an inspection unit, I have much higher clearance than ordinary Nikkes, so I accessed the Central Government database directly...

lines.speaker: eyeri
lines.text: and still came up empty-handed.

lines.speaker: eyeri
lines.text: If there's nothing in the Central Government database either,

lines.speaker: eyeri
lines.text: then the only conclusion is that someone deliberately erased her records.

lines.speaker: eyeri
lines.text: Nothing exists without leaving a trace, after all.

lines.speaker: eyeri
lines.text: And I don't believe any record can ever be completely wiped.

lines.speaker: eyeri
lines.text: Every piece of data would leave a trace somewhere.

lines.speaker: eyeri
lines.text: And that's how I ended up here...

lines.speaker: eyeri
lines.text: at the Forbidden Library.

lines.speaker: eyeri
lines.text: I know I'm not supposed to be here, but... could you please make an exception just this once?

lines.speaker: eyeri
lines.text: I just need to check on something about Dorothy, and I'll be right out, I swear.

lines.speaker: eyeri
lines.text: Pretty please?

lines.speaker: eyeri
lines.text: Just once! Really, just this once... I only need 5 minutes—no, 3 minutes! Okay?
Arcana casts a wary glance at Eyeri.
